title: Design System: Renal Relay — inherited starter UI

components.name: Starter Primary Link
components.description: Page-local outbound link styled as the primary starter action.
components.css: .ds-starter-primary { display: flex; height: 3rem; width: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: #171717; padding: 0 1.25rem; color: #ffffff; font: 500 1rem/1.5 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-starter-primary:hover { background: #383838; } .ds-starter-primary:focus-visible { outline: auto; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-starter-primary { background: #ededed; color: #0a0a0a; } .ds-starter-primary:hover { background: #cccccc; } } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-starter-primary { width: 158px; } }

components.name: Starter Secondary Link
components.description: Page-local outbound link styled as the secondary starter action.
components.css: .ds-starter-secondary { display: flex; height: 3rem; width: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0 1.25rem; color: #171717; font: 500 1rem/1.5 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-starter-secondary:hover { border-color: transparent; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04); } .ds-starter-secondary:focus-visible { outline: auto; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-starter-secondary { border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.145); color: #ededed; } .ds-starter-secondary:hover { border-color: transparent; background: #1a1a1a; } } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-starter-secondary { width: 158px; } }

narrative.overview: This document records the existing create-next-app screen only. It is not the Renal Relay visual direction. The user has asked to keep that direction open.
keyCharacteristics: Single centered starter page with two outbound calls to action.
Light/dark appearance follows the operating-system color preference.
Tailwind utilities provide layout and framework-default colors; no shared component library exists.
dos: Do describe these values as inherited starter defaults when maintaining the current page.
Do use PRODUCT.md and the relevant product brief before designing a Renal Relay workflow screen.
donts: Don't present the starter colors or pill actions as approved Renal Relay branding.
Don't infer a dashboard layout, clinical status palette, or patient-facing visual language from this single starter page.
Don't treat Tailwind's default palette utilities as custom design tokens.
